about: Test vectors of canvas's rule of boxes, R37 in docs/decisions.md: from the strokes a workbook's page shows and its boxes to the box each stroke is in, or none — the draft — and the table of the filled boxes. A proposal for the eval protocol, epic E3 in spec's RUN.md (В47 in canvas's RUN.md): the protocol's own vectors come in spec's releases, and canvas will test against those.

formulas.tenths: a stroke's points in whole tenths of a page unit, round(10 × v), half up; a box [top, left, bottom, right] in whole units is 10 × each in tenths, L, T, W = right − left and H = bottom − top
formulas.bounds: x0, x1, y0, y1: the least and the most of the stroke's points in tenths
formulas.size: 1000 × (x1 − x0) ≤ limit × W and 1000 × (y1 − y0) ≤ limit × H
formulas.middle: 1000 × (x0 + x1) ≥ 2 × (1000 × L − margin × W) and 1000 × (x0 + x1) ≤ 2 × (1000 × (L + W) + margin × W), and the same down with y, T and H
formulas.held: the points of the stroke with 1000 × x ≥ 1000 × L − margin × W, 1000 × x ≤ 1000 × (L + W) + margin × W, and the same down
formulas.box: of the boxes whose size and middle hold, the one with the most points held, and of those the earliest in the order of the boxes — the task's: by item, then by slot, each from 1; none is the draft
formulas.filled: a box is filled if a stroke's box is it; the table lists the filled boxes in order, the IDs of each ascending
formulas.numbers: for points on the page, 1000 × 1400, every whole number above stays below 2^31; an int64 holds each

cases.name: edge-digits
cases.about: Ten answers of one digit 50 high, pushed past the right, the left, the top and the bottom of their boxes by 0 to 20 units: each is its box's.

cases.name: edge-signs
cases.about: «4», «5», «+», «×» and «=», each two strokes, pushed past an edge of their boxes by 6 to 14 units: one stroke of each may stand outside, and the character is its box's.

cases.name: numbers
cases.about: Answers of two digits, 36, 44 and 50 high, moved up to 20 units right or 12 left: the last digit of the widest stands past the box's edge.

cases.name: mixed-numbers
cases.about: The page of many kinds of lines: answers of one to three digits 40 to 60 high — «635» and «135» as wide as their boxes — and a «<».

cases.name: fractions
cases.about: Fractions in two storeys, digits 30 to 44 high and bars 28 to 80 long, and two bars of 120 and 140, wider than their boxes; a «<» and a «=» answer the comparisons.

cases.name: inline
cases.about: Fractions written in a line with «/», 36 to 44 high: «4/10» at 40 is 109 wide, past both sides of its box.

cases.name: comparisons
cases.about: Comparison signs 20 to 50 high as the answers of ten lines; the «=» of the ninth stands across the bottom edge of its box, its lower bar 4 units past it.

cases.name: neighbours
cases.about: Seven boxes 32 apart, five in a row and two in the row below: each answer drifts 4 to 14 units into the gap toward a box beside or the row below, and stays its own box's.

cases.name: across
cases.about: A line from the middle of one box to the middle of the next is no answer; a tall «1» running 14 units below its box is its own; a scribble over two boxes is either; a line from the row above through a box and below it is the draft.

cases.name: draft
cases.about: A column sum between the columns of boxes, a «7» 8 to 48 units right of four boxes and dots 8 and 16 off a box are the draft; dots 2 and 4 off it are either; a dot in its corner is its own.

cases.name: rings
cases.about: A ring round the answer within its box is its own; a ring round a whole box is either; a ring round the whole line, its text and its box, is the draft.

cases.name: crossed
cases.about: A line through a whole line and a cross over another are the draft; an answer crossed out in its box and the right one written beside it, up to 25 units past the edge, are the box's.

cases.name: erased
cases.about: An answer erased and written again, a page cleared and the clearing undone, and the last digit of an answer erased and written anew: only the strokes the page shows count.

cases.name: edge-digits
cases.about: Ten answers of one digit 50 high, pushed past the right, the left, the top and the bottom of their boxes by 0 to 20 units: each is its box's.

cases.name: edge-signs
cases.about: «4», «5», «+», «×» and «=», each two strokes, pushed past an edge of their boxes by 6 to 14 units: one stroke of each may stand outside, and the character is its box's.

cases.name: fractions
cases.about: Fractions in two storeys, digits 30 to 44 high and bars 28 to 80 long, and two bars of 120 and 140, wider than their boxes; a «<» and a «=» answer the comparisons.

cases.name: comparisons
cases.about: Comparison signs 20 to 50 high as the answers of ten lines; the «=» of the ninth stands across the bottom edge of its box, its lower bar 4 units past it.

cases.name: edges
cases.about: Boxes of their own — 100 × 100, 120 × 80, and two that overlap — and dots and lines on and a tenth past each widened edge and the limit, rounding onto an edge, and strokes two overlapping boxes may both take: the more points held, then the earlier box.

cases.name: seeded-1
cases.about: A workbook of seed 1 on the page fractions-ten: an answer in every box, and draft 8 to 48 units off the boxes.

cases.name: seeded-2
cases.about: A workbook of seed 2 on the page mixed: an answer in every box, and draft 8 to 48 units off the boxes.
